Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, and the surface portion having no protrusions extending from a surface center to an outer perimeter; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity while being transferred directly from the surface portion without the use of additional instruments.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and b. the surface portion is free of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion across its entirety from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially smooth and free from protrusions extending therefrom.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar and free from features that could trap cosmetics during use.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and further secured by a friction fit or adjustable mechanism that accommodates different finger sizes.
